description: This file contains a PHP class named Zone, which is a controller within the OpenCart admin system for managing localisation zones. It includes methods for listing, adding, editing, and deleting zones, handling HTTP request parameters, generating URLs, and loading views with data. It's part of the administrative interface for managing geographical zones in the localisation module.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: A controller class for managing localisation zones within the OpenCart admin system. Handles CRUD operations, listing, filtering, sorting, and pagination of zones.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the localisation/zone language pack, sets the page title, processes request filters, and renders the zone list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of zones by loading language labels and rendering the view with getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the view for listing zones, including handling filters, sorting, pagination, and data preparation.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the form for creating or editing a zone, including loading existing data if applicable, and setting up action URLs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding or updating) localisation zone data, performs permission checks, validation, and responds with a JSON success or error message.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected localisation zones, performs permission checks, deletes zones via the model, and returns JSON response indicating success or errors.
